caption: The worked example labels four strings by ambiguity type, in the order (a) to (d). The two syntactic cases are highlighted: (b) has two structures, while (d) has one string with two attachment sites.

spec.title: Worked example: ambiguity types
spec.aria: Four boxes top to bottom for the worked example: (a) bank is lexical, (b) Visiting relatives is syntactic, (c) pass the salt is pragmatic, and (d) with binoculars is syntactic attachment; the two syntactic boxes are highlighted.
